name: fems-backend
description: FEMS — Microservices backend with API Gateway

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,auth,ext,insp,report,notif -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white "npm run dev -w @fems/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @fems/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @fems/extinguisher-service" "npm run dev -w @fems/inspection-service" "npm run dev -w @fems/report-service" "npm run dev -w @fems/notification-service"
scripts.start: concurrently -n gateway,auth,ext,insp,report,notif "npm run start -w @fems/api-gateway" "npm run start -w @fems/auth-service" "npm run start -w @fems/extinguisher-service" "npm run start -w @fems/inspection-service" "npm run start -w @fems/report-service" "npm run start -w @fems/notification-service"
